$comment: The rdf-array organisation's repositories and the dependency edges between them, read by repos.html and checked by tools/manifest-check.py against GitHub and against each repository's build files. A stack is a repository with "stack": true plus every repository its runtime deps reach. Edit by hand; see the repos-manifest skill.

repos.name: owlapi-array
repos.description: the OWL API 4.5.29, the line Protégé 5.6 loads, for [OWL-array](https://rdf-array.github.io/rdf-array/owl-array.html): OWL's own lists read and written as sequences, a data sequence as an `OWLSequence` individual with the built-in `ra:member`, `ra:length`, `ra:first` and `ra:last`, and a reasoner decorator that expands them for a stock reasoner (HermiT tested). Done 2026-10-26 through the `owl-array` skill's §1; the Rio formats, the proper Functional-style, OWL/XML and Manchester spellings and Protégé are not.

repos.name: protege-owl-array

targets.text: SHACL-array: [shacl-array.md](shacl-array.html), implemented in [jena](#jena)'s jena-shacl, with the suites [data-shapes](#data-shapes) and [data-shapes-contrib](#data-shapes-contrib), 2026-10-25.

**rdf-canonize and rdf-isomorphic** (JavaScript; Python rdf-canon) — canonicalization and isomorphism with blank nodes inside sequences; the JavaScript forks' tests need it. Impact 2–3, utility 4. [Assessment](targets.md#canonicalization-and-isomorphism).
**A public Fuseki-array endpoint** — jena-array's Fuseki, deployed; any time. Impact 1, utility 3. [Assessment](targets.md#mappings-clients-and-user-interfaces).
**[Yasgui](https://github.com/rdfjs/Yasgui)** (TypeScript: Yasqe, Yasr; TriplyDB's original is archived) — SPARQL editor and results viewer, once there is a public endpoint. Impact 2–3, utility 3.
**[SPARQLWrapper](https://github.com/RDFLib/sparqlwrapper)** (Python) — SPARQL client, once there is a public endpoint. Impact 1, utility 2.

**[QLever](https://github.com/ad-freiburg/qlever)** (C++) — a compressed-index SPARQL engine for billions of triples; a project of its own. Impact 5, utility 4. [Assessment](targets.md#qlever-the-scale-showcase).
**[RDF4J](https://github.com/eclipse-rdf4j/rdf4j)** (Java) — the other Java stack: model, Rio, SAIL stores, ShaclSail. Impact 4–5, utility 3. [Assessment](targets.md#rdf4j).

**The rdf-ext / Zazuko RDF/JS stack** (JavaScript: @rdfjs/data-model, @rdfjs/dataset, rdf-ext, @zazuko/env, clownface, rdf-validate-shacl) — the second RDF/JS ecosystem; N3.js-array and types-array exist. Impact 2 each, utility 3. [Assessment](targets.md#the-second-rdfjs-stack-and-rdflibjs).
**[rdflib.js](https://github.com/linkeddata/rdflib.js)** (JavaScript) — Solid's library, which already has a `Collection` term kind. Impact 3, utility 3.
**[Morph-KGC](https://github.com/morph-kgc/morph-kgc)** (Python) — RML, with RML-CC's `gatherAs` producing a sequence; when JSON-LD-array settles. Impact 2, utility 3.
**[pyld](https://github.com/digitalbazaar/pyld)** (Python) — a JSON-LD-array port for Python users, when JSON-LD-array settles. Impact 2, utility 2.
**[Sophia](https://github.com/pchampin/sophia_rs)** (Rust) — the other Rust RDF library; not while Oxigraph serves. Impact 3, utility 2.

**[OWL API](https://github.com/owlcs/owlapi), Protégé** (Java) — OWL, whose syntax is made of lists, and whose DL could not look into a list in the data. Done: [owlapi-array](https://rdf-array.github.io/rdf-array/repos.html#owlapi) for [OWL-array](https://rdf-array.github.io/rdf-array/owl-array.html) (2026-10-26); Protégé is the next target below.

**[Protégé](https://github.com/protegeproject/protege) 5.6.9** (Java) — without a fork first: owlapi-array's OSGi bundle in place of `bundles/owlapi-osgidistribution.jar`, and a reasoner plugin, `protege-owl-array`, that wraps HermiT in `SequenceAwareReasonerFactory`; `protege-array` only when the editor must change ([#21](https://github.com/rdf-array/rdf-array/issues/21)). Done without a fork: [protege-owl-array](https://rdf-array.github.io/rdf-array/repos.html#protege-owl) (2026-10-27), and the walk-through of [examples/fhir](examples/fhir/index.html) §4 in Protégé. Impact 1 (swap and plugin) to 3 (fork), utility 4. [Assessment](targets.md#protégé).

**The FHIR ontology's generator** ([kindling](https://github.com/HL7/kindling)'s `FhirTurtleGenerator`, Java) — fhir.ttl types a repeating element with `allValuesFrom` on the element type, which over rdf-array types the list; `ra:member only` is the fix, and [examples/fhir](examples/fhir/index.html) shows the published axiom inconsistent with list data. Impact 1, utility 3. [Assessment](targets.md#the-fhir-ontology).
